# infisical_cert_manager_certificate_request_approval_policy (Resource)

Create and manage a Certificate Manager application's approval policy for certificate requests. A certificate requested through the application from one of the policy's certificate profiles waits for the approvals the policy asks for before it is issued.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_cert_manager_application" "payments" {
  name = "payments"
}

# Approvers of an application policy, users and groups alike, have to be members of the application
resource "infisical_cert_manager_application_user" "security_lead" {
  application_id = infisical_cert_manager_application.payments.id
  email          = "security-lead@example.com"
  role           = "admin"
}

resource "infisical_cert_manager_application_group" "platform" {
  application_id = infisical_cert_manager_application.payments.id
  group_id       = "<platform-group-id>"
  role           = "operator"
}

# Certificates requested through the payments application from the public TLS profile need the
# security lead's approval, then one approval from the platform group
resource "infisical_cert_manager_certificate_request_approval_policy" "payments_public_tls" {
  name           = "Payments public TLS"
  application_id = infisical_cert_manager_application.payments.id
  profile_names  = ["public-tls"] # The name of an infisical_cert_manager_certificate_profile

  bypass_for_machine_identities = true # Automation requesting these certificates skips the approval
  max_request_ttl               = "7d" # A request nobody approves within a week expires

  steps = [
    {
      name               = "Security review"
      required_approvals = 1
      approvers = [
        { type = "user", id = "<security-lead-user-id>" },
      ]
    },
    {
      name               = "Platform sign-off"
      required_approvals = 1
      notify_approvers   = false # Approvers see the request in Infisical, but are not emailed
      approvers = [
        { type = "group", id = infisical_cert_manager_application_group.platform.group_id },
      ]
    },
  ]

  depends_on = [
    infisical_cert_manager_application_user.security_lead,
    infisical_cert_manager_application_group.platform,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the Certificate Manager application the policy covers. Every approver must be a member of the application. Changing it creates a new policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the approval policy.
- `profile_names` (Set of String) The names of the certificate profiles whose certificate requests need approval.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The approval steps, in the order a request goes through them. A request moves to the next step once the current one has the approvals it requires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `bypass_for_machine_identities` (Boolean) Whether certificates requested by machine identities skip the approval. Defaults to false.
- `max_request_ttl` (String) How long a certificate request can wait for approval before it expires, such as `7d` or `12h`. Must be between 1 hour and 30 days. Leave it out for requests that never expire.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the approval policy.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `approvers` (Attributes Set) The users and groups that can approve at this step. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--approvers))
- `required_approvals` (Number) How many of the step's approvers must approve before the request moves on. Must be between 1 and 100.

Optional:

- `name` (String) An optional name for the step.
- `notify_approvers` (Boolean) Whether the step's approvers are notified when a request reaches it. Defaults to true.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--approvers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.approvers`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the approving user or group.
- `type` (String) The type of the approver. Options: user, group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a certificate request approval policy by its ID
terraform import infisical_cert_manager_certificate_request_approval_policy.example <policy_id>
```
